# CR-9204: Acme Manufacturing credit limit increase to $1,300,000

**No, it cannot be approved.** The requested $1,300,000 is above Acme's maximum of **$1,150,000** under the 2026 policy, even with the parent guarantee counted. A higher approver cannot fix this.

**The request.** CR-9204 is in Northstar ERP as submitted. It asks to raise C-1001's limit from $250,000 to $1,300,000. Sarah Chen submitted it on 2026-09-23, relying on the Acme Group parent guarantee. Its status is Pending Approval.

**The customer.** These are all the same company: ERP C-1001 "Acme Mfg. Holdings", CRM-2048 "Acme Manufacturing", and the guarantee's "Acme Mfg. Holdings d/b/a Acme Manufacturing". They share DUNS 04-812-7730 and the address 2200 N Industrial Pkwy, Milwaukee. CRM records the account as **Strategic**.

**Policy in force.** CREDIT-POLICY-2026 governs, since it covers 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31.

**Payment history.** The rule is that no invoice due in the 12 months before the request may be paid, or unpaid, more than 30 days after its due date. Acme passes:

| Invoice | Due date | Paid | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-60412 | 2025-11-28 | 2025-11-24 | Paid on time |
| INV-62011 | 2026-07-25 | 2026-07-22 | Paid on time |
| INV-62305 ($720,000) | 2026-10-02 | Unpaid | Not yet due on the request date |

**Maximum limit.**
- The Strategic tier maximum is $750,000.
- GRT-ACME-2026 is registered and in force from 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31. It names this customer and covers up to $400,000.
- The maximum is therefore $750,000 + $400,000 = **$1,150,000**.
- The request is **$150,000 over** that maximum.

**Authority.** Sarah Chen is an Enterprise Account Executive and has no approval authority. A limit of $1,300,000 would need:
- **approval** from the Director of Finance, Elena Novak; and
- **concurrence** from VP Sales, Michael Torres, because the account is Strategic and the limit is over $500,000.

Neither of them submitted the request, so separation of duties is satisfied. However, eligibility fails, so no approver can authorize this limit.

**Noted for any follow-up:**
- A request at or below $1,150,000 could be submitted instead. It would need the same approval and concurrence.
- As of today (2026-10-08), INV-62305 for $720,000 is 6 days past due. It does not affect this request, but it would make Acme ineligible if it stays unpaid more than 30 days past its due date (that is, after 2026-11-01).

              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "Sarah Chen (EMP-101, Enterprise Account Executive)", "basis": "guarantee"},

                  "late_invoices": []},

                "required_role": "Director of Finance, with VP Sales concurrence (Strategic account over $500,000)",
                "approvers": [{"name": "Elena Novak", "role": "Director of Finance", "kind": "approval"},
                              {"name": "Michael Torres", "role": "VP Sales", "kind": "concurrence"}]},
  "evidence": [
    "structured/credit_requests.csv: CR-9204, C-1001, 250000 -> 1300000, sarah.chen@northstar.example, 2026-09-23, Pending Approval",
    "structured/customers.csv: C-1001 Acme Mfg. Holdings, DUNS 04-812-7730, 2200 N Industrial Pkwy, Milwaukee WI",
    "structured/crm_accounts.csv: CRM-2048 Acme Manufacturing, Strategic, DUNS 04-812-7730",
    "structured/erp_credit.csv: C-1001 current limit 250000",
    "structured/erp_invoices.csv: INV-60412 paid 2025-11-24 (due 2025-11-28); INV-62011 paid 2026-07-22 (due 2026-07-25); INV-62305 due 2026-10-02, not yet due on request date",
    "OWM register: CREDIT-POLICY-2026 (in force 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31)",
    "OWM register: GRT-ACME-2026, Acme Group Holdings, Inc. guarantees Acme Mfg. Holdings only, up to $400,000, 2026-01-01 to 2027-12-31",
    "structured/employees.csv: Sarah Chen EMP-101 Enterprise Account Executive; Elena Novak EMP-402 Director of Finance; Michael Torres EMP-200 VP Sales"
  ],

    {"what": "INV-62305 ($720,000, due 2026-10-02) is unpaid and past due as of 2026-10-08; if it stays unpaid beyond 2026-11-01, Acme becomes ineligible under the 30-day payment rule for later requests", "who": "Accounts Receivable (Robert Hernandez)", "blocking": false}
